text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I decided to stop by the shopping mall to get Taiki Shuttle to buy a folding umbrella.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Eh~... A folding umbrella-desu ka~?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
There's no need for that kind of thing, yes!
It's heavy, and carrying it around is such a hassle, yes!
choice_data_list: You'll be in trouble if it suddenly starts raining, you know?
You'll be in trouble if it suddenly starts raining, you know?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That happened before too, didn't it!
Well~... back then—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I will share your umbrella, Trainer!
So I'll be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No problem even if the umbrella is small!
I will squeeze myself super tiny!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What!? Is there such a thing
as you not being around, Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Awawa... I didn't think about that!
I was totally sure you'd be able to come anytime...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...That's a pinch!
I'll go buy an umbrella!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~, but there are so many kinds of umbrellas, yes.
Which one should we choose, I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, what kind of umbrella
do you think I should buy?
choice_data_list: A light umbrella you can run with.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That umbrella
would surely be perfect for me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't look too heavy even if I put it in my bag!
The fact that I can run with it makes total sense to me, YES!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Please lend me an umbrella!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ah... it's being repaired. The umbrella couldn't withstand my running speed... and it broke.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't run at full speed in the rain...
Teaching her that, I lent her my umbrella.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~... Won't that make it too heavy, though?
I'll give it a try for now, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, clerk! Pleeease let me
test this heavy-looking umbrella!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: …………Alright!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, this is way, way heavier than I thought!
This is quite unexpected!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, this is NICE! I love it!
It will serve as my barbell!!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, clerk persooon!
Give me 100 of those umbrellas from earlier, pleeease!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't need that many umbrellas... And so,
I ended up having to persuade her...
